text_block_list.text: Held at the end of the year, the highly anticipated Grand Prix race: the Arima Kinen.

Although she wasn't running...
Hishi Miracle had come to Nakayama Racecourse to spectate.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, by any chance...
Could it possibly be...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it would've been
a pretty good match if I were in it?
choice_data_list: You've started talking like that now, huh...
You've started saying things like that, haven't you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A-Am I getting too ahead of myself?
Still, after managing to run that well
in the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I can't really hold a candle
to Kris S-chan, of course."
"Yes, one of the runners in today's race, Symboli Kris S, is..."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here she comes, Symboli Kris S!
The Umamusume who conquered this year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Very few Umamusume in history have conquered the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in their Classic Year!
What kind of race will she show us today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

Having achieved a brilliant feat, she enters the race fully prepared.
And standing in her way is—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta put on the most fun run ever today♪
To live up to everyone's cheers!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A narrow defeat at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...
I will definitely return the favor!

The top favorite is the Umamusume
with the nobility of a princess, Fine Motion.
Followed by the familiar crowd-pleaser, Narita Top Road.

A lineup of powerhouses where anyone could win,
without question, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we see
what our rivals are capable of?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh, not quite that much. But hey, I'm an Umamusume aiming for the Tenno Sho (Spring) too, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to radiance, I feel like I'm getting
pretty close to Kris S-chan now.

Hishi Miracle's abilities are definitely
improving by leaps and bounds. However...

"This race looked like it would also make clear
where she stood relative to Symboli Kris S."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ha, everyone's out here zoning out on this luxury cruise liner.
However—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes peeled. Right at your feet,
a small boat bearing terrifying pirates is closing in.

And the race starts.
The final stretch turned into—an unexpected turn of events.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the one breaking away from the formidable pack
is none other than—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Front-Runner, Tap Dance City!!
No one can reach her, no one, no one, no one can catch her!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeehk...!

The dark horse Tap Dance City's buoyant front-running style.
At first glance, it seemed like an unorthodox gamble, but—

Her fierce charge showed no sign of stopping.
A true dark horse had undeniably arrived on the scene.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Running like this...
I could never do that...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And the gap is huge...
There's no way to catch up...
It's... already over...
However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Heh—!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —What!?

There was a single black shadow
chasing after the pirate ship, pulling up alongside it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Kris Ssss!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Just—the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S!!
Right before the finish line, she sweeps past with incredible speedâ!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: This year's Grand Prix Umamusume is Symboli Kris S! It's Symboli Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ooooh, whyyyyyyyy!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Why, Kris S!? Are you trying to say
you were watching me when nobody else was!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The opponent is—nobody.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No one in particular.
I only execute the Mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: You should drink some canned coffee, like 『BOSS』.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Kris S... chan... I thought I was getting just a little closer to that radiance...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the way she ran just now...
If it had been me..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Not at all...
Not at all, not in the slightest...
And on the way home that day—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Kris S-chan is amazing...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'd thought so before, but still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I didn't understand at all.
Just how truly incredible it was...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I finally understand now. Now that I'm able
to run reasonably well myself, at long last...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whether she wins or loses,
Kris S-chan is always looking toward her goal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't slack off or get cocky
like normal people do...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Her mindset is completely different...
Maybe to Kris S-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "That glory... Even winning the Autumn Tenno Sho in her Classic year..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: This is just the beginning...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She'll get so much stronger from here on out.
Because her "resolve" is on a whole other level.

A difference in "resolve." Something I knew—
yet hadn't truly grasped until now.

Today, Hishi Miracle seemed to vividly
realize the fundamental difference between them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Can I... really keep up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I somehow managed to pull through this year, but I don't feel like I can keep coasting along like this next year.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"In the end... I'm still just me.
Even if I've grown a little bit..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Will I really be able to manage going forward?

I won't say it forcefully.
I'll simply and quietly convey my conviction.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaah... It's because I wanted to answer those words that I've made it this far, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, even if it's a lie, I just wanna let Trainer hype me up like this.
Ahaha...
"An unforgettable bitterness. Even so, Hishi Miracle offered a faint smile..."

"Harboring a sliver of hope and a mountain of anxiety,
her Classic year thus came to a close."
